messages:
maria: Quick note from rehearsals — intermittent HDMI artifacting on the big screen. If it recurs during the live stream well cut to the backup laptop and record locally.

jordan: OK. Ill have the spare laptop on Chair 2 with the USB capture. Should we just record locally or also live-stream from it?

sachin: Prefer local recording to avoid another network hop. Keep the main stream active unless it fails, then switch.

elaine: For Q&A, please dump all audience questions into the shared doc so I can triage. Ill ping Marta for leadership answers.

marta: Ill handle leadership follow-ups. Tag with #allhands-followup and assign to me.

maria: Minimal fallback checklist: spare laptop ready, external SSD attached, OBS fallback profile loaded, captions active. If HDMI drops, shout here and well switch.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: T-10m post link to Q&A doc and caption status.

jordan: Posted the doc link and set a T-5 Slack reminder for attendees to add questions.

sachin: SSD prepped and labeled BACKUP-ALLHANDS. Running a quick record test now.

maria: Dry-run log snippet: [10:07:12] obs: fallback scene loaded; [10:07:13] recorder: writing /mnt/ssd/allhands-fallback.mkv

elaine: Add an "asked by" column in the Q&A sheet so we can trace follow-ups.

marta: Also mark any roadmap-related Qs and I'll work with PMs to capture them.

maria: Ill confirm readiness at T-2 on this thread. Keep the runbook tight, no extra streams unless needed. :thumbsup:
